requirement.description: The next_token function fails to correctly identify boolean tokens (TRUE/FALSE) in various contexts. Tests show that boolean values are not being properly recognized, causing test failures like test_boolean_true and test_boolean_false.
requirement.contract: The next_token function should correctly identify boolean keywords "true" and "false" and return appropriate token types (TRUE/FALSE) with correct start/end positions. The function should handle boolean tokens consistently regardless of surrounding whitespace or context.

requirement.description: The parse_obj function doesn't properly handle boolean values (True/False) in arrays and dictionaries. It fails to correctly parse boolean literals like [true false] or {/flag true}.
requirement.contract: The parse_obj function should correctly parse boolean literals and convert them to Python boolean values (True/False) when encountered in arrays or dictionaries. The function should distinguish between boolean keywords and other keywords.

requirement.description: The next_token function has issues with incomplete token detection and handling. Some tests expect None as the token type for incomplete tokens, but the implementation isn't handling this correctly.
requirement.contract: The next_token function should properly detect and return None as the token type for incomplete tokens at the end of input, especially for VALUE, NAME, TEXT, HEX_STRING, KEYWORD, COMMENT, ARRAY, DICT, and STREAM token types.

requirement.description: The parse_obj function has issues with parsing arrays containing references (e.g., [2 0 R 42 0 R]). It's not properly converting numeric values followed by 0 R into complex numbers.
requirement.contract: The parse_obj function should correctly parse reference patterns (integer 0 R) in arrays and convert them to complex numbers (e.g., 2j, 42j). The function should identify these patterns and convert them appropriately.

requirement.description: The next_token function has incorrect handling of comments and whitespace in various contexts. Tests show failures with comment parsing and token identification.
requirement.contract: The next_token function should correctly handle comment tokens, skipping past comments and properly identifying subsequent tokens. It should also correctly handle whitespace separation and token boundaries.
